name: Stipendia
tagline: Production payroll, settled with institutional precision.
positioning: Stipendia is the payroll and compliance system of record for independent filmmakers, unit producers, and freelance crew who need studio-grade paycheck accuracy without a studio-sized accounting department.

hero.sub: Stipendia converts your call sheets, deal memos, and timecards into compliant paychecks, W-2s, and residual-ready records — governed by the same rate rules the majors use, on a budget an independent production can actually approve.

features.title: Union and non-union rate logic
features.description: Encode IATSE, DGA, and SAG-AFTRA rate schedules alongside your own flat deals. Meal penalties, turnaround, and overtime tiers calculate automatically on every timecard.

features.title: Deal memo to paycheck
features.description: Upload a signed deal memo and Stipendia extracts the rate, kit fee, and box rental, then holds them as the governing terms for that crew member across the entire shoot.

features.title: Multi-state withholding
features.description: Location shoots trigger the correct state and local withholding automatically, with reciprocity handled and quarterly filings prepared for your signature.

features.title: Wrap-ready reporting
features.description: Close out a production with a single ledger: cost reports by department, 1099 and W-2 packages, and a documented audit trail for financiers and completion bonds.

features.title: Residual-ready records
features.description: Every payment is tagged with role, project, and rights metadata, so future residuals and reuse calculations start from clean, defensible data.

features.title: Same-day disbursement
features.description: Approve a batch and crew are paid the same business day, with itemized digital stubs that explain every fringe, deduction, and penalty in plain language.

testimonials.quote: I run three commercial spots a month with rotating crews. Stipendia replaced the spreadsheet I dreaded every Friday. Timecards in, compliant checks out, and my accountant stopped calling.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: We shot across four states last quarter. The withholding and the SAG-AFTRA math simply resolved themselves. The wrap report was the first one my financier accepted without a single follow-up question.
testimonials.name: Declan Faircloth

testimonials.quote: As a freelance gaffer who also hires my own crew, I needed something that treated a one-person LLC seriously. Stipendia gave me clean W-2s and stubs my team actually trusts.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand
